read.en: Coherent rose 0.7% on Oct 23 to $209.29, trading between $203.55 and $215.38. It is below the falling 5-day ($223.7), 10-day ($244.3), 30-day ($284.8) and 100-day ($313.5) averages and the rising 200-day ($295.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($275.80), and RSI is 30.
read.zh: Coherent 10月23日上涨 0.7%，收于 $209.29，盘中区间 $203.55–215.38。股价位于下行的 5 日（$223.7）、10 日（$244.3）、30 日（$284.8）和 100 日均线（$313.5）以及上行的 200 日均线（$295.4）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$275.80），RSI 为 30。

read.en: The $203.55 low dipped under the $204.4–204.6 support (Feb 17 and Oct 22 lows) before the close recovered; the $215.4 high stayed under the $217.8–220.7 resistance. Resistance is $215.4, then $217.8–220.7 (Oct 20 and Jul 29 lows) and $223.7–231.6 (5-day, Oct 16 low). Support is $203.6–204.6, then $200. A close above $220.7 would target $231.6; a close below $203.5 would open $200.
